newsitem.title: USA: BE Aerospace wins United contract.
newsitem.headline: BE Aerospace wins United contract.

text.p: BE Aerospace Inc said on Friday it received a $130 millon in-flight entertainment and seating-equipment contract from United Airlines, a unit of UAL Corp.
The company said it would provide its B/E 2000M individual-passenger entertainment system for use in the carrier's Boeing 777, 747-400 and 767-300 widebody fleets.
While the deal was subject to conditions, United has authorized BE Aerospace to start necessary engineering. Delivery of the video systems, worth about $60 million, is scheduled for February.

In addition, BE Aerospace said it would supply Premiere Connoisseur Class seats on all of its widebody fleets, including B747s, B767s, B77s and DC-10s, as well as first-class setas on all of its narrowbody fleets.
The value of the seating order is expected to reach about $70 million. Deliveries are scheduled to begin this year.
